function.description: This function configures a ShaderMaterial for a Three.js scene, applying custom shaders, textures, and properties based on the provided data, texture list, and 3D object. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

property.description: The properties specific to the ShaderMaterial being configured. This is JavaScript dict type parameter in string representation.

textures.description: A list of textures to be used in the ShaderMaterial. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type String; they are not in string representation.

object3D.description: The 3D object within which the ShaderMaterial is being applied. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.
